ticket.title: Incorrect holding detected in reporting
ticket.description: Synthetic example: reporting for subsidiary ES, class CHANNEL shows local code CH_ES mapped to H_X, but the same local code in other subsidiaries maps to H_CH.

precedents.summary: Cross-subsidiary consistency helps detect incorrect holding mappings.

args.query: incorrect holding mapping CH_ES CHANNEL ES reporting

args.sql: SELECT LOCALCODE, CLASSID, SUBSIDIARYCODE, HOLDINGID FROM MD_LOCALVALUE_T WHERE LOCALCODE = 'CH_ES' AND CLASSID = 'CHANNEL' AND SUBSIDIARYCODE = 'ES'
args.purpose: Read the current mapping for local code CH_ES in subsidiary ES

args.sql: SELECT HOLDINGID, CLASSID, PARENTID FROM MD_HOLDINGVALUE_T WHERE HOLDINGID = 'H_X' AND CLASSID = 'CHANNEL'
SELECT LOCALCODE, CLASSID, SUBSIDIARYCODE, HOLDINGID FROM MD_LOCALVALUE_T WHERE LOCALCODE = 'CH_ES' AND CLASSID = 'CHANNEL' AND SUBSIDIARYCODE <> 'ES'
args.purpose: Compare mappings of the same local code in other subsidiaries

args.sql: SELECT HOLDINGID, CLASSID, PARENTID FROM MD_HOLDINGVALUE_T WHERE HOLDINGID = 'H_CH' AND CLASSID = 'CHANNEL'

SELECT LOCALCODE, CLASSID, SUBSIDIARYCODE, HOLDINGID, CHANGED_AT FROM MD_LOCALVALUEHISTORY_T WHERE LOCALCODE = 'CH_ES' AND CLASSID = 'CHANNEL' AND SUBSIDIARYCODE = 'ES' ORDER BY CHANGED_AT DESC LIMIT 1
args.purpose: Check recent history for local code CH_ES in ES

args.sql: SELECT SUBSIDIARYCODE, NAME, COUNTRY FROM CF_SUBSIDIARIES_T WHERE SUBSIDIARYCODE = 'ES'

args.text: Local code CH_ES in subsidiary ES, class CHANNEL, is mapped to H_X. Peer subsidiaries (PT, IT) map the same local code to H_CH, and the ES history record shows H_CH as the previous mapping. H_CH exists and belongs to the expected hierarchy. The correction is to remap CH_ES to H_CH.

resolution.analysis: Local code CH_ES in ES is mapped to H_X, while peer subsidiaries consistently map CH_ES to H_CH. The ES history record also shows H_CH as the previous mapping. H_CH exists and is in the expected hierarchy, so the mapping should be corrected to H_CH.
resolution.proposed_correction: Set MD_LOCALVALUE_T.HOLDINGID to H_CH for LOCALCODE='CH_ES', CLASSID='CHANNEL', SUBSIDIARYCODE='ES'.

evidence.detail: CH_ES in ES maps to HOLDINGID H_X
H_X exists but is under H_ROOT_WRONG hierarchy
peer subsidiaries PT and IT map CH_ES to H_CH
H_CH exists and belongs to H_ROOT hierarchy
ticket 60: cross-subsidiary consistency detects incorrect holding mappings

SELECT HOLDINGID, CLASSID, PARENTID FROM MD_HOLDINGVALUE_T WHERE HOLDINGID = 'H_CH' AND CLASSID = 'CHANNEL'

SELECT SUBSIDIARYCODE, NAME, COUNTRY FROM CF_SUBSIDIARIES_T WHERE SUBSIDIARYCODE = 'ES'
